text.title: AI-Assisted Development — Procedure
text.summary: Nine steps that turn informal assistant use into a reviewable workflow record: write the tool-to-task map, write the security-critical block-list, commit a context file per tool, exclude secrets and check retention terms, adopt the four-block prompt, verify introduced dependencies per diff, break the function to test generated tests, label and review every AI diff, and compare defect, revert and churn rates at each cadence.

step.name: write-tool-to-task-map
step.input: The tools in use (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, other); the seven task classes.
step.action: Fill `team`, `owner` and the `tool_task_map` input: for boilerplate-scaffolding, unit-tests, refactor, code-review, documentation, data-migration and infrastructure, name the tool (or `ai-off`) and the review checkpoint (self-review, one-reviewer, two-reviewers-non-prompter, ai-off).
step.decision-gate: "We use Copilot for everything" is not a map; data-migration and infrastructure cannot sit below two reviewers (r-tool-to-task-map-written, r-security-critical-block-list).

step.name: write-block-list
step.input: The repo layout; the paths of auth, authorization, crypto, payments, PII, secrets loading, production IaC and migrations.
step.action: Fill `block_list` with the eight minimum areas, each with `paths[]` and a `policy` of `ai-off` or `two-reviewers-non-prompter`; wire a CI or CODEOWNERS check so an `ai-assisted` PR touching a block-listed path with fewer than two reviewers cannot merge.
step.decision-gate: Any of the eight areas missing fails the record (r-security-critical-block-list).

step.name: commit-context-files
step.input: Build and test commands; conventions; forbidden patterns.
step.action: Create or refresh `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursor/rules` (or `.cursorrules`) and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` for every tool in the map; record each in `context_files` with `last_reviewed`.
step.decision-gate: A tool in the map with no context file, or one with stale commands, is a defect (r-repo-context-file-maintained).

step.name: exclude-secrets-and-check-retention
step.input: Secrets files and data directories; each vendor's data-usage terms.
step.action: Add `.cursorignore` / `.claudeignore` / `.gitignore` patterns for `.env*`, secrets and customer data and record them in `exclusion_file`; read each tool's retention terms and record `tool_retention` with the source URL and date.
step.decision-gate: A tool whose terms are unchecked is `ai-off` for proprietary code until checked (r-no-secrets-or-customer-data-in-prompts).

step.name: adopt-four-block-prompt
step.action: Commit the template into the repo and record `prompt_template` with `blocks: Context, Task, Requirements, Output`; every hand-written prompt names a pattern file in Context and an exact path in Output.
step.decision-gate: A prompt without a pattern file or an output target is rejected at review (r-structured-prompt-four-blocks).

step.name: verify-introduced-dependencies
step.action: For every new package, import or API call: confirm the package exists in the registry at the pinned version, the import resolves, and the signature matches the documentation; list new dependencies in the PR description.
step.decision-gate: A dependency the reviewer cannot find in the registry blocks the merge (r-verify-introduced-dependencies-and-apis).

step.name: break-the-function-for-generated-tests
step.input: Output of `templates/gen-tests.sh` or any AI-written test file.
step.action: Read every test for a value assertion; break the function under test on purpose and run the file; delete tests that stay green, mock the unit under test, or assert hallucinated values.
step.output: Test file where at least one test fails when the function is broken.
step.decision-gate: Assertion-free tests are deleted, not fixed (r-ai-tests-must-assert-and-fail-when-broken).

step.name: label-and-review-every-ai-diff
step.input: The PR; the checkpoint from the map.
step.action: Record `ai_assisted_label` with `auto_merge_disabled: true`; the prompter self-reviews line by line, applies the label, and requests the reviewers the checkpoint demands. Write `decision`; fill `templates/skeleton.md.j2`; run `scripts/validate-ai-assisted-dev.py --file`; commit the record.
step.decision-gate: An unlabelled or auto-merged AI diff is outside the methodology (r-ai-diff-reviewed-like-human-code).

step.name: compare-defects-at-cadence
step.input: PRs over the period, split by the `ai-assisted` label; defect escapes, reverts, two-week churn.
step.action: At each `review.cadence` fill `review.last_outcome` with both groups' `pr_count`, `defect_escape_rate`, `revert_rate`, `churn_2w_rate` and the dashboard URL in `evidence[]`; list `worse_on`; if non-empty, tighten the map (stricter checkpoint or `ai-off` for the offending task class), record `action`, set `map_tightened: true` and bump `team.record_version`.
step.output: Outcome recorded; map tightened when worse.
step.decision-gate: A review that records worse numbers and changes nothing is invalid (r-defect-rate-tracked-ai-vs-human).

list.item: Record validates via `scripts/validate-ai-assisted-dev.py`, including context-file coverage, retention-versus-map and tighten-when-worse checks.
Every AI-assisted PR in the period carries the label and went through its checkpoint.
The last outcome compares both groups on all three metrics.
